verdict.rationale: Latham's Emerging Companies & Growth page states deal volume ("hundreds of emerging company financings totaling billions of dollars every year"). It describes financing work spanning angel and seed investments to structured debt and equity, for companies "of all sizes" across venture and growth capital hubs. However, it never explicitly names priced equity rounds by stage (Series A through late-stage growth rounds) and lists no representative transactions. Missing for 10: explicit description of priced equity rounds by series stage, explicit late-stage round coverage, named representative venture financings, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm's venture financing practice covers priced equity rounds from seed through late stage, with stated deal volume or representative transactions on its own pages

citations.quote: we advise on hundreds of emerging company financings totaling billions of dollars every year.
